phrases.text: Which video uniquely uses fresh citrus juice to enhance the broth's flavor profile?
a hand squeezing fresh lemon juice into a simmering broth pot
citrus slices floating in a clear liquid soup base

report_hints: Which video uniquely uses fresh citrus juice to enhance the broth's flavor profile?

Distinguish between generic garnish and actual juice extraction/addition if visible
Verify that the citrus is fresh (e.g., cut fruit, squeezing action) rather than bottled or dried
